blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: As AI's mathematical capabilities rapidly improve, meaningful benchmarks are shifting from university-level problems and math olympiads to research-level mathematics. The Ramanujan Challenge is a benchmark comprised of research-level problems in number theory, including unpublished results and open conjectures. It presented concrete formulas for mathematical constants whose correctness can be checked numerically, while their proofs may require non-obvious mathematics. Here, we analyze the Challenge submissions, measuring the relative success of different AI models, Computer Algebra Systems (CAS), and formal tools. We find correct submissions that are conceptually distinct from the official solutions, and a proof of one of the published open conjectures. Evaluating the submissions exposed a second challenge: judging complex proofs reliably at scale. We introduce an AI-assisted evaluation pipeline for natural language proofs, CAS code, and Lean formalizations that assesses semantic and logical correctness. Compared with the conventional one-shot LLM judgment, our pipeline reduces false-positive verdicts on natural language proofs from 23% to 6% and improves judgment accuracy on supporting code from 46% to 58%. This approach provides a methodology for evaluating research-level mathematics at scale, with potential applications across mathematics and AI for science.
blocks.zh: 随着AI的数学能力迅速提高,有意义的基准正在从大学层次的问题和数学奥林匹克转向研究层次的数学. 拉马努扬挑战(英语:Ramanujan Challenge)是一个由数论的研究层次问题所构成的基准,包括未发表的结果和开放的猜想. 它提出了数学常数的具体公式,其正确性可以通过数字来检查,而其证明可能要求非明显的数学. 在这里,我们分析挑战提交,衡量不同AI模型,计算机代数系统和正式工具的相对成功. 我们发现在概念上不同于官方解决办法的正确意见,并证明公开发表的一种推测。 评估提交材料暴露出第二个挑战:在规模上可靠地判断复杂的证据。 我们为自然语言证明、化学文摘社代码和精益正规化引入了人工辅助评估程序,评估语义和逻辑正确性。 与传统的一发LLM判断相比,我们的管道将自然语言证明的假阳性判断从23%降低到6%,并将支持代码的判断精度从46%提高到58%. 这种方法为评价研究层次的数学提供了一种规模化的方法,在数学和科学的AI中都有潜在的应用.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Benchmarks measuring the mathematical capabilities of AI systems are getting saturated at an accelerating pace.
School-level problem sets such as GSM8K and MATH ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ; Hendrycks et al., 2021 ) were followed by university-level benchmarks, such as U-Math and ASyMOB ( Chernyshev et al., 2025 ; Shalyt et al., 2025 ) , and math olympiad questions ( Zheng et al., 2022 ; He et al., 2024 ; Gao et al., 2025 ) .
The frontier of LLM evaluation is now shifting towards research-level mathematics ( Glazer et al., 2025 ; Phan et al., 2026 ; Abouzaid et al., 2026 ; Peyronnet et al., 2026 ) .
Meaningful assessment at this level requires a rare combination: problems at the research frontier whose solutions are unpublished to avoid training-data contamination - but are known privately.
blocks.zh:
测量AI系统数学能力的基准正在加速饱和。
学校层面的问题组合,如GSM8K和MATH(Cobbe等人,2021年;Hendrycks等人,2021年),随后是大学层面的基准,如U-Math和ASyMOB(Chernyshev等人,2025年;Shalyt等人,2025年),以及数学奥林匹克问题(郑等人,2022年;He等人,2024年;Gao等人,2025年)。
LLM评价的前沿正在转向研究一级的数学(Glazer等人,2025年;Phan等人,2026年;Abouzaid等人,2026年;Peyronnet等人,2026年)。
这一层次的有意义的评估需要一种罕见的组合:研究前沿的问题,其解决办法没有公布以避免培训数据污染----但众所周知。

blocks.en:
In this work, we present the results of the Ramanujan Challenge for AI ( Shalyt et al., 2026 ) , a collection of ten research-level numerically verifiable number theory problems.
Of these, 8 were proved by the authors but unpublished, and 2 are open conjectures. The collection was released as a benchmark for AI-assisted proving.
Our analysis shows that the submissions which were most successful at producing correct natural language proofs used models from the Claude and GPT families, while such proofs from submissions combining Lean with CAS outperformed those that relied on any single tool, suggesting benefits from diversified supporting evidence.
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们介绍了"拉马努扬挑战AI"(Shalyt等人,2026年)的结果,这集包含十个研究层面的数值可验证数理论问题.
其中,8份经提交人证明但未公布,2份为公开推测。 该集作为AI协助证明的基准发布.
我们的分析表明,最成功地提供正确自然语言证明的材料使用了克劳德和普通语系的模型,而将Lean与化学文摘社(CAS)结合起来的这种证明则超过了依赖任何单一工具的证明,这表明了多样化支持证据的好处。

blocks.en:
Notably, some of the complete proofs were submitted by amateur mathematicians, and one of the open conjectures had multiple correct proofs submitted, showing the potential of advanced AI to lower the barrier of entry to parts of mathematical research.
Submitters to the challenge, who obtained correct solutions include a person with no higher mathematical education and whose solution to one of the challenge problems was found to be simpler than the original solution from the authors. They also include young independent researchers with no mathematical training, one of whom solved a famous open mathematical problem prior to their participation in the challenge, and a high-school student who achieved significant results towards proving one of the challenge conjectures. The use of AI thus allows people accross broader backgrounds to access and advance research-level mathematics, democratizing mathematics and opening the door to cross-field research and contributions.
blocks.zh:
值得注意的是,一些完整的证明是由业余数学家提交的,其中一个开放的猜想有多个正确的证明提交,显示了高级AI降低部分数学研究进入障碍的潜力.
质疑的提交者获得了正确的解决方案,其中包括一个没有受过高等数学教育的人,他对于质疑问题之一的解决方案被认为比作者最初的解决方案简单. 他们还包括没有接受数学训练的年轻独立研究者,其中一位在参与挑战前解决了一个著名的开放数学问题,还有一位高中生在证明挑战猜想之一方面取得了显著成绩. 因此,使用AI使得人们能够跨越更广泛的背景,获取和推进研究一级的数学,使数学民主化,并为跨领域的研究和贡献打开大门。

blocks.en:
Obtaining the results required addressing a second challenge: evaluating large quantities of complex mathematical proof candidates.
The recent boom in AI-assisted mathematics ( Alon et al., 2026 ; Feng et al., 2026 ; Ju et al., 2026 ) , while producing some incredible results ( OpenAI, 2026 ; Alpöge, 2026 ) ,
created an avalanche of mathematical claims – making this problem widespread beyond benchmarks.
The Ramanujan Challenge illustrates this scale: participants sent a total of 228 submissions, containing a total of 4802 pages of natural language mathematical proofs and 1,079,380 lines of code across Lean, Python, Mathematica and Sage.
Recent mathematical benchmarks approach automated validation in different ways: fully relying on a large language model (LLM) as a judge ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , using an LLM to check equivalence against a known ground truth ( Peyronnet et al., 2026 ) , or using deterministic code to verify LLM-generated answers ( Shalyt et al., 2025 ) .
Other benchmarks, such as IMO-GradingBench and μ \mu -Math ( Luong et al., 2025 ; Chernyshev et al., 2025 ) , evaluate LLMs as judges of mathematical proofs and solutions, showing the difficulty of achieving high agreement with expert assessments.
blocks.zh:
取得结果需要应对第二个挑战:评估大量复杂的数学证明候选人。
最近AI辅助数学的繁荣(Alon等人,2026年;Feng等人,2026年;Ju等人,2026年),同时产生了一些令人难以置信的结果(OpenAI,2026年;Alpöge,2026年),
造成一系列数学权利主张 — — 使这一问题超越了基准范围。
"拉马努扬挑战"说明了这个尺度:参与者共发送了228份呈文,其中共包含4802页自然语言数学证明和1,079,380行代码横跨利安,Python,Mathematica和Sage.
近代数学基准采用不同方式进行自动化验证:完全依靠大语言模型(LLM)作为裁判(张等人,2025年),使用LLM来对照已知的地面真理来验证等效性(Peyronnet等人,2026年),或使用定型码来验证LLM生成的答案(Shalyt等人,2025年).
其他基准,如海事组织-Grading Bench和μ\mu-Math(Luong等人,2025年;Chernyshev等人,2025年),评价LLMs作为数学证明和解决方案的判断者,表明难以与专家评估达成高度一致。

blocks.en:
In this paper, we present a novel AI-assisted pipeline, depicted in Figure 1 , for the purpose of large scale validation of
complex multi-format proofs, which include natural language, CAS code, and Lean formalizations.
We assess the Ramanujan Challenge submissions, comparing verdicts across three evaluation methods: our pipeline with and without a human expert in the loop, and a baseline LLM-as-a-judge.
Using the evaluation pipeline reduces false positive grading by a factor of 4 for natural language proofs and 11.5 for CAS/Lean code, and increases agreement with human evaluation of the code from 46% to 58%, relative to a baseline of the same LLM without the pipeline.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们提出一个新型AI辅助管道,用图1描述,目的是大规模验证
复杂的多格式证明,包括自然语言,CAS代码,以及Lean正规化.
我们评估拉马努扬挑战案的提交情况,比较了三种评价方法的判决:我们与旁听的人类专家的管道和没有人类专家的管道,以及作为法官的LLM基线。
利用评价管道将自然语言证明的假正分分级减少4倍,将化学文摘社/Lean编码减少11.5倍,将人类对编码评价的一致程度从46%提高到58%,相对于没有管道的同一LLM基线而言。

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Overview of the evaluation pipeline.
blocks.zh: 图1:评价程序概述。

blocks.en: Broadly, as AI systems produce mathematical and scientific results faster than experts can verify them, validation is becoming a central bottleneck ( Tao, 2026 ; Kontorovich, 2025 ; Codreanu et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 广义地说,由于AI系统产生数学和科学结果的速度快于专家所能验证的速度,验证正成为中心瓶颈(Tao, 2026;Kontorovich, 2025;Codreanu等人, 2026).

blocks.en: Our approach suggests combining natural language reasoning with complementary computational certificates, helping scale validation of AI-generated claims across mathematics and science.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法建议将自然语言推理与互补的计算证书相结合,帮助对AI生成的跨数学和科学的主张进行规模验证.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work and Novelty
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作和小说

blocks.en: Related work. Checking how well LLMs can reason is a relatively new area of interest. Last evaluated in December 2025, the Frontier Math benchmark ( Glazer et al., 2025 ) considered reasoning capabilities of LLMs across multiple domains of research level mathematics. They concluded that the best models of the time were insufficient for advanced research, “revealing a vast gap between AI capabilities and the prowess of the mathematical community”. The First Proof ( Abouzaid et al., 2026 ) benchmark focuses on unpublished research problems whose answers are known to experts. These works attest to the high cost of human feedback, and the importance of monitoring the progress of AI as a research assistant. One of the aims of this manuscript is to answer this question for current models.
blocks.zh: 相关工作. 检查LLMS能有多么合理是一个相对较新的关注领域. 上一次评价是在2025年12月,边疆数学基准(Glazer等人,2025年)考虑了LLMs跨越研究层次数学多个领域的推理能力. 他们的结论是,当时的最佳模型不足以进行高级研究,“揭示了人工智能能力和数学界力量之间的巨大差距”。 第一证(Abouzaid et al., 2026)基准侧重于未发表的研究问题,其答案为专家所知. 这些工作证明了人类反馈的高成本,以及监督AI作为研究助理的进展的重要性. 这个手稿的目的之一是为现在的模型回答这个问题.

blocks.en: The other goal is to develop an AI-assisted evaluation pipeline for given solutions. The authors of First Proof stress on the difficulty of manual evaluation when there is a large volume of submissions for complex problems. There are fewer works on the subject of using AI as graders. Using LLMs as teaching assistants for undergraduate discrete math examinations was studied in ( Sapkota and Murshed, 2026 ) . The paper suggests that AI can apply harsh point deductions under stricter policy conditions. LLM as a grader has also been studied in ( Xie et al., 2024 ) , where it is used to evaluate responses to six questions in an examination on an Operating Systems Course. Google’s DeepMind constructed IMO-GradingBench in ( Luong et al., 2025 ) , showing that autograders coupled with reasoning from Gemini seem to correlate well with human evaluation on IMO problems. ( Yu et al., 2026 ) focuses on evaluation of handwritten college mathematics using AI.
blocks.zh: 另一个目标是为特定解决方案开发AI辅助评价管道. First Profof强调,在复杂问题提交大量材料时,人工评估有困难。 以AI为分级器题材的作品较少. 利用LLMS作为本科离散数学考试的教学助理,在(Sapkota and Murshed, 2026)进行了学习. 论文提出,AI可以在更严格的政策条件下实施严厉的点扣. LLM在(Xie等人,2024年)中也作为分级者进行了学习,在操作系统课程的考试中,它被用来评价对六个问题的答复. Google的DeepMind在(Luong等人,2025年)中构建了海事组织-Grading Bench, 这表明自动升级机与双子座的推理似乎与人类对海事组织问题的评价密切相关。 (Yu et al., 2026)专注于使用AI对手写大学数学的评价.

blocks.en: Novelty. To the best knowledge of the authors, we are the first to construct an AI-assisted evaluation pipeline as well as test it in the context of large scale evaluations of research-level computational mathematics questions. Our evaluation pipeline, when used by an LLM agent, reduces false positive grading by a factor of 4 for natural language proofs and 11.5 for CAS/Lean code, and increases agreement with human evaluation of the code from 45% to 58%. This demonstrates an improvement in the direction of automated AI verification of natural language complex mathematical proofs.
blocks.zh: 小说. 据作者们所知,我们首先构建了一个AI辅助评价管道,并在对研究层次计算数学问题进行大规模评价时对其进行测试。 我们的评价管道,当使用LLM剂时,将自然语言证明和CAS/Lean代码的假正分率分别减少4倍和11.5倍,并将人类对代码的评价从45%提高到58%。 这表明在自然语言复合数学证明的自动AI验证方向上有所改进.

blocks.en: We further contribute to the analysis of CAS as means of proof or verification for such mathematical questions, an unexplored area of research. We analyze in particular the combined use of CAS and Lean and see that it is accompanied by correct natural language proofs more so than the use of either one in isolation, opening a door to further research on the interconnection of CAS and formal theorem assistants in AI mathematics.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步帮助分析化学文摘社作为证明或核实这些数学问题的手段,这是一个尚未探讨的研究领域。 我们特别分析了CAS和Lean的结合使用,并看到它附带了正确的自然语言证明,而不是单独使用其中之一,打开了对CAS和正式定理助理在AI数学中的互联性进行进一步研究的大门。

blocks.en: 3 The Trust Spectrum
blocks.zh: 3 信任谱

blocks.en: Our proposed paradigm for measuring the validity of solutions to mathematical questions is the “trust spectrum”. While theoretically most mathematical proofs can be completely formalized, in practice, trust in a mathematical proof lies on a spectrum: soft verification - such as numerical validation or probabilistic checking; intermediate verification - symbolic validation by a computer algebra system (CAS); and hard verification - machine-checked theorem proving like with Lean.
blocks.zh: 我们提议的衡量数学问题解决办法有效性的模式是“信任范围”。 虽然理论上大多数数学证明可以完全正规化,但在实践中,对数学证明的信任就在于一个频谱上:软核查——如数字验证或概率检查;中间核查——计算机代数系统(CAS)的象征性验证;硬核查——机器核对的定理,如与Lean验证.

blocks.en: CAS rely on symbolic representations and computational rules rather than axiomatic representations of mathematical objects. They can include data produced by otherwise verifiable mathematical statements, which can be used in subsequent reasoning and proofs in the common sense of the word ( Barendregt and Wiedijk, 2005 ) . Provability, however, is not always formally decidable via CAS.
blocks.zh: CAS依赖于符号表示和计算规则,而不是数学对象的逻辑表示. 它们可以包括由其他可核查的数学报表生成的数据,这些数据可以用于后续推理和该词常识中的证明(Barendregt and Wiedijk, 2005.). 然而,可证明性并不总是可以通过CAS正式确定。

blocks.en: Figure 2 : The trust spectrum.
blocks.zh: 图2:信任谱。

blocks.en: ITPs such as Lean enforce strict rules for line-by-line verification of proofs. They can produce dependency graphs of the proof on other theorems, going right down to the used definitions and axioms. For this reason, we place formal verification the highest on our trust spectrum. Moreover, for a human to verify a formal proof, one needs to inspect only the definitions, used axioms, and problem statement, significantly reducing verification time.
blocks.zh: 利安等ITP严格实施逐行验证证明规则. 它们可以在其他定理上生成证据的依赖图,直接到使用的定义和定理. 为此,我们把正式核查置于我们信任的首位。 此外,一个人要核实正式证据,只需要检查定义、使用动因和问题说明,就可大大减少核查时间。

blocks.en: In this paper, one of our aims is to measure how well AI systems can evaluate a given solution, using the trust spectrum as a metric. This view of trust creation in AI results can also generally help decide when to invest substantial time exploring AI outputs, and which parts of a new claim to focus on.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们的目标之一是衡量AI系统能够以信任谱作为衡量尺度,对某一解决方案进行评估的程度。 AI结果中对建立信任的这种观点,一般也可以帮助决定何时投入大量时间探索AI产出,以及新主张的哪些部分需要关注.

blocks.en: 4 The Challenge
blocks.zh: 4 挑战

blocks.en: The Ramanujan Challenge focuses on explicit formulae involving important mathematical constants such as π \pi , e e , ζ ⁡ ( s ) \zeta(s) etc. The form they take are of recurrences, continued fractions, series, and integrals. Most of these formulae were discovered by exploring trajectories arising in Conservative Matrix Fields, using the ramanujantools package ( Ramanujan Machine Group, 2025 ; Elimelech et al., 2024 ; Weinbaum et al., 2025 ; Raz et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 拉马努扬挑战侧重于涉及重要数学常数的明确的公式,如 \\pi, e , \\\(s)\zeta(s) 等. 它们采取的形式是复发、持续分数、序列和组成部分。 这些公式大多是通过利用拉马努扬机器组(Ramanujan Machine Group,2025年;Elimelech等人,2024年;Weinbaum等人,2025年;Raz等人,2025年)探索保守矩阵场产生的轨迹而发现的。

blocks.en:
The Ramanujan Challenge, published on arXiv ( Shalyt et al., 2026 ) and on the Ramanujan Machine website ( The Ramanujan Machine, 2026 ) , ran from July to August 2026. It comprised of 8 questions and 2 conjectures, listed in Appendix A and Appendix B respectively.
The solutions to these questions were (to the knowledge of the authors) previously unpublished.
blocks.zh:
在arXiv(Shalyt et al., 2026)和Ramanujan Machine网站(The Ramanujan Machine, 2026)上发表的"拉马努扬挑战"从2026年7月运行到8月. 它包括8个问题和2个猜想,分别列于附录A和附录B。
这些问题的解决办法(据提交人所知)以前没有公布。

blocks.en: The challenge asked for solutions comprising of the following data, in descending order of importance: formal proof, CAS-based derivations and natural language proofs. The reason for this order of importance is discussed in Section 3 .
blocks.zh: 这一挑战要求找到由下列数据组成的解决办法,其重要性依次为:正式证明、基于化学文摘社的衍生数据和自然语言证明。 第3节讨论了这种重要性的原因。

blocks.en: At the time of posting the Challenge, the prevalent LLMs could not solve any of the problems (with one-shot prompts). The challenge received submissions from people within and outside the mathematics community, many of which did succeed in solving some of the problems.
blocks.zh: 在发布挑战赛时,流行的LLMs无法解决任何问题(用一发提示). 这一挑战得到了数学界内外人士的呈文,其中许多人确实成功地解决了一些问题。

blocks.en: 5 Methodology
blocks.zh: 5. 方法

blocks.en: In this section, we discuss the construction of our AI-assisted pipeline, described in Figure 1 . The final goal of this pipeline is to reduce human time and effort invested into largescale grading of proofs that require multiple formats.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们讨论建造我们的人工智能辅助管道的问题,如图1所述。 这一管道的最终目标是减少人力投入的时间和精力,用于大规模分级需要多种格式的证明。

blocks.en: 5.1 Evaluation Pipeline
blocks.zh: 5.1 评价管道

blocks.en: For a submission, the pipeline provides a human reviewer with AI-generated summaries for each file in the submission, along with an AI-generated review connecting all of them.
blocks.zh: 对于提交材料,管道向人审查员提供材料中每个文件的AI生成摘要,以及AI生成的连接所有文件的审查.

blocks.en: The major components of the pipeline can be broken down into: Step 1: Basic Grade Files. Every Python script is executed and given a “basic grade” using our custom script. This is passed as input in the next step. These files comment on the successful compilation of the given code, as well as summarize the script’s structure (comment density, imports, cyclomatic complexity and a keyword-based symbolic/numeric classification) and its observed behavior under a fixed runtime environment (exit status, execution time and standard output).
blocks.zh: 管道的主要组件可以细分为: 第1步:基本等级文件. 每个 Python 脚本都使用我们的自定义脚本执行并给予一个“基本等级”。 下一步将将此作为投入。 这些文件评论了给定代码的成功编译,并总结了脚本的结构(评论密度,导入,百科复杂度和基于关键词的符号/数字分类)及其在固定运行时间环境中的观察到的行为(退出状态,执行时间和标准输出).

blocks.en: Step 2: AI Summary. For every submission, two AI summary files are generated, one for the natural language proof and one for the code.
blocks.zh: 步骤2:大赦国际摘要。 每次提交,都会生成两个AI摘要文件,一个用于自然语言证明,一个用于代码.

blocks.en: Natural language summary. A GPT 5.6-Sol agent with high reasoning effort reads each PDF file in the submission folder and produces a summary file. The file contains a summary of the proof, a list of issues, and (code) files mentioned in the proof.
blocks.zh: 自然语言总结. 一个GPT 5.6-Sol代理,在提交文件夹中读取每个PDF文件,并生成一个摘要文件. 文件包括证据摘要、问题清单和证据中提到的(代码)文件。

blocks.en: CAS Summary. A Claude Opus 5 agent with high reasoning effort reads the CAS/Lean files in each submission folder as well as the basic grade files when present. It produces a file containing a summary of the code, a list of issues, and a list of files that pertain to the verification of the proof.

blocks.en: Natural language proofs. Evaluation of natural language proofs is the most self-explanatory. Correct solutions are those that comprise the mathematical steps necessary to reach the conclusion of the statement at hand, with no arrival at statements without proof, except for steps that follow simply from standard methods within the field. This is, as all human verification of natural language proofs, susceptible to human error, as discussed in Section 3 .
blocks.zh: 自然语言证明. 对自然语言证明的评价是最不言自明的. 正确的解决方案是那些构成达成手头语句结论所必须的数学步骤,没有证据就无法到达语句,只是从本领域的标准方法中遵循的步骤. 正如第3节所讨论的,这是人类对自然语言证明的所有核查,容易发生人为错误。

blocks.en: CAS. CAS code has been evaluated in the same way as a natural language proof. To be classified as correct, it should reproduce all of the steps necessary for a mathematical proof. Code that verified only part of the statements of the natural language proof, or had a small number of seemingly recoverable errors has been deemed partial, and other code, or code that does not compile has been labeled as having major issues.
blocks.zh: 化学文摘社 CAS. CAS代码的评价与自然语言证明相同. 为了被归类为正确,它应复制数学证明所需的所有步骤。 仅核实自然语言证明部分语句的代码,或者少量看似可挽回的错误的代码,被认为是部分的,其他没有编译的代码或代码被标注为存在重大问题.

blocks.en: Lean. Lean was the only ITP used by the participants of the challenge. Its evaluation is much simpler than that of natural language proofs and CAS code. It requires only a semantic inspection of the definitions relating to the problem statement and object, and a check that the code compiles successfully, in addition that the code does not use statements without formal verification via the use of sorry or axiom statements.
blocks.zh: 灵曰. 精益是挑战参与者使用的唯一IPP. 它的评价远比自然语言证明和CAS代码的简单. 它只需要对与问题语句和对象有关的定义进行语义检查,并检查代码是否成功编译,此外,通过使用歉意语句或语义语句,代码不使用未经正式核实的语句.

blocks.en: Lean code that does not compile or where the definitions don’t match the problem have been classified as having major issues. Code that does compile and matches a significant partial step towards a proof, or code that imports known theorems in the field without formal proof via the use of sorry or axiom statements have been classified as partial.
blocks.zh: 或定义与问题不符的地方, 编译并匹配向证据方向迈出的重要部分步骤的代码,或者通过使用歉意语或语义语句在没有正式证据的情况下输入领域已知定理的代码被归类为部分.

blocks.en: Some Lean formalizations relied on certain statements without proof, via use of statements such as axiom , constant , sorry , or admit . We see also that only 11% of natural language solutions accompanying such formalizations were found to be correct, with a higher 49% for natural language proofs coming with Lean formalizations not including such statements. This demonstrates a correlation between correctness of the natural language proof and completeness of the Lean formalization.
blocks.zh: 有些倾向性形式化依靠某些没有证据的言论, 这种形式化的正确性,以及提交材料中的自然语言证明,都因这些陈述的使用而大大降低,如图9所示。 包括这些语句形式化的代码都没有被判断为正确,而其他提交材料中包含Lean代码的代码占58%。 我们还看到,只有11%的自然语言解决方案与这种形式化相关联,这些解决方案是正确的,其中49%的自然语言证明与精益形式化相关联,不包括这些声明。 这表明自然语言证明的正确性与Lean形式化的完整性之间存在关联.

blocks.en: 7.3 Analysis of the Evaluation Pipeline
blocks.zh: 7.3 评价管道分析

blocks.en: We analyze the evaluation pipeline as a method of increasing performance of LLM agents in the correct classification of challenge solutions. A Claude Opus 5 agent was used twice, once via one-shot prompting and once with the use of our evaluation pipeline, to classify the parts of the solution as correct, partial or with major issues. These were compared to human verdicts, which were considered the reference labels, with results detailed in Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 我们分析评价程序是提高LLM剂在正确划分挑战解决方案方面的性能的一种方法。 Claude Opus 5剂曾两次通过一发即发和一次使用我们的评估管道,将溶液部分归为正确、部分或重大问题。 这些判决与人类判决相比较,这些判决被视为参考标签,结果详见表1。

blocks.en: Use of the pipeline increased overall agreement with the human verdict from 65.7% to 66.4% for natural language proofs and from 45.8% to 58.3% for code.
blocks.zh: 使用管道将人类判决的总协议从65.7%增加到66.4%,自然语言证明从45.8%增加到58.3%。

blocks.en: Without the pipeline, the agent was too strict on only 2.9% of solutions when using one-shot prompting in the evaluation of natural language proofs, and on only 4.2% of them for CAS or Lean code. It was too lax on 31.4% of natural language proofs and 50.0% of code, ignoring issues in them. 23.4% of the natural language proofs, and 38.3% of the code had been incorrectly classified as Correct.

blocks.en: These issues have been corrected with use of the pipeline, with reduction from 31.4% to 18.2% for natural language and 50.0% to 12.5% for code in the agent being too lax, and reduction from 23.4% to 5.8% for natural language and from 38.3% to 3.3% for code in false positives, less by factors of 4 and 11.5 respectively.
blocks.zh: 随着管道的使用,这些问题得到了纠正,天然语言从31.4%下降到18.2%,代理人的编码从50.0%下降到12.5%,自然语言从23.4%下降到5.8%,假阳性语言从38.3%下降到3.3%,分别减去4和11.5%。

blocks.en: 8 Limitations
blocks.zh: 8 限制

blocks.en: There is uncertainty in the experiment results with regards to variation between participants and tools used. Challenge participants submitted solutions to as low as 1 and as high as all 10 challenge problems, potentially skewing the dataset. The participants were furthermore self-admitted to the challenge and chose and self-reported their use of tools for the solutions, introducing potential biases.
blocks.zh: 试验结果对参与者与所用工具之间的差别有不确定性。 挑战参与者为10个挑战性问题提出了最低至1个和最高的解决方案,可能扭曲数据集。 此外,与会者还自觉接受挑战,选择并自报了对解决方案工具的使用,带来了潜在的偏见。

blocks.en: Evaluation of the submissions also leads to an amount of uncertainty, as they rely on human judgment, which is prone to error. Due to time and monetary constraints, evaluation of each natural language proof and CAS or Lean code was done by a single human evaluator, as described in Section 5 and without cross-checking. This leaves evaluation prone to human error and potentially skewed by the specific backgrounds of the evaluators.
blocks.zh: 对提交材料的评估还会导致一定程度的不确定性,因为它们依赖于容易出错的人类判断。 由于时间和金钱的限制,每个自然语言证明和CAS或Lean代码的评价均由单一的人类评价员进行,如第5节所述,没有交叉核对。 这使得评价容易发生人为错误,并可能因评价人员的具体背景而扭曲。

blocks.en: 9 Discussion and Outlook
blocks.zh: 9 讨论和展望

blocks.en:
As AI-assisted mathematics produces results at an increasing rate, reliable and scalable validation is becoming crucial.
Our analysis shows that a structured evaluation pipeline can improve judgment quality even when the underlying LLM is unchanged.
We expect this advantage to persist as models improve, particularly if evaluation pipelines evolve in parallel to model improvement.
blocks.zh:
由于人工智能辅助数学以更高的速度产生结果,可靠和可扩展的验证正变得至关重要。
我们的分析表明,即使基本的LLM没有变化,结构化评价程序也能提高判断质量。
我们期望随着模型的改进,这一优势将继续存在,特别是如果评价程序与模型的改进同时发展。

blocks.en:
The Ramanujan Challenge results show that research-level number theory problems are increasingly within reach of AI-assisted solvers.
Benchmarks at this level may therefore saturate as well, just as earlier benchmarks have,
motivating a continuous effort to construct up-to-date evaluations that track the advancing research frontier.
Open conjectures offer a renewable source of such problems, but because they lack known proofs, their use as benchmarks depends on reliable evaluation methods that do not require a priori ground truth to work well, such as the approach presented here.
blocks.zh:
拉马努扬挑战(英语:Ramanujan Challenge)的结果显示,研究层面的数字理论问题越来越能被AI辅助的解答者掌握.
因此,与先前的基准一样,这一级别的基准也可能饱和,
推动不断努力,建立跟踪研究前沿的最新评价。
公开猜想为这些问题提供了可再生来源,但由于它们缺乏已知的证据,它们作为基准的使用取决于可靠的评价方法,这些方法并不需要先验的真相才能成功,例如这里介绍的方法。

blocks.en:
Our analysis shows that natural language proofs supported by both Lean and CAS code were, on average, more successful than those relying on a single tool.
One plausible explanation is that the two forms of evidence are complementary: Lean guarantees the logical validity of the statement as formalized, whereas CAS can efficiently check intricate symbolic and numerical computations that are hard to formalize.
Together, they can therefore provide stronger evidence than either alone.
This suggests a broader role for CAS as a supporting tool for mathematical proofs. CAS certificates are often more readable than full formalizations while remaining machine-checkable, and tighter integration among CAS, proof assistants, and LLMs could turn verified computations into certified proof steps that combine readability with rigor.
blocks.zh:
我们的分析表明,平均而言,由Lean和CAS代码支持的自然语言证明比依靠单一工具证明更成功。
一种合理的解释是,这两种形式的证据是相辅相成的:利恩保证声明正式化的逻辑有效性,而CAS可以有效地检查难以正式化的复杂符号和数字计算。
因此,两者加在一起,可以提供比两者都更强有力的证据。
这表明CAS作为数学证明的辅助工具具有更广泛的作用. 化学文摘社证书往往比完全正规化更可读,而机器则仍可验,化学文摘社、证明助理和LLMs之间的更紧密的整合可以将经核实的计算变成可读性和刚性相结合的经核证的证明步骤。

blocks.en:
More broadly, the setting considered here – a natural language claim accompanied by code-based indirect evidence
– extends beyond number theory.
Similar situations arise throughout mathematics and increasingly in varied areas of AI for science, where generated claims may be supported by code, simulations, or data analyses.
As the volume of such results grows, systems capable of autonomously assessing the validity of a claim and the sufficiency of its supporting evidence may become increasingly crucial.
blocks.zh:
更广义地说,这里所考虑的设定是自然语言索赔,并附有基于代码的间接证据
——超越数论.
在整个数学中也会出现类似的情况,在科学AI的不同领域也越来越多,在那里产生的主张可能得到代码、模拟或数据分析的支持。
随着这类结果数量的增加,能够自主评估索赔的有效性及其佐证证据的充足性的系统可能变得越来越重要。
